reason: Wrong vertical and wrong buyer: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals is a publicly traded clinical-stage pharma company (NASDAQ: AMLX, ~136 employees, Cambridge MA) developing avexitide/AMX0035/AMX0114 for PBH, Wolfram syndrome and ALS — it is not a low-voltage systems integrator, electrical contractor, or property-technology vendor serving multifamily/student housing/hospitality/senior living, and it has no install base on which to add managed Wi-Fi, surveillance, access control or service plans. The two matched jobs are pharma functions (Senior Director, External Manufacturing = CDMO network for peptides/oligonucleotides; Manager, R&D Operations = toxicology/bioanalytical planning), and today's full 27-role feed is entirely clinical, regulatory, commercial and biostatistics hiring — the only technology titles (Director, IT R&D and Quality Applications; Manager, IT G&A Applications) are enterprise pharma application IT, which is the opposite of Shake's field infrastructure/deployment practice. No line in any live posting redescribes his EDP (contracted recurring revenue covering zero months of payroll), and a public company with a full C-suite and SVP bench is not a fractional-CTO engagement.
